items.markdown:
![Combining Microneedling with Polynucleotides for Skin Renewal](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10091044-1509-0139-0000-8535adb6d8dd:4)
Combining **microneedling** with **polynucleotides** is `a regenerative aesthetic treatment that boosts skin healing, hydration, and collagen production at a cellular level`.

### How It Works

- **Microneedling:** Ultra-fine needles create thousands of microscopic channels in the skin, triggering a natural wound-healing response that stimulates collagen and elastin production.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:4852085842223812585&ibp=oshop)
- **Polynucleotides:** These bio-stimulatory DNA fragments (often derived from salmon or trout) are applied topically during or after the needling process. The micro-channels allow them to penetrate deep into the dermis, where they signal cells to repair tissue, reduce inflammation, and improve microcirculation.[[1]](https://littleforay.com/blog/microneedling-polynucleotides-the-power-pairing-for-texture-tone-elasticity/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:4852085842223812585&ibp=oshop)

### Key Benefits

- **Texture & Pores:** Smooths fine lines, wrinkles, and crepey skin, while minimizing enlarged pores.[[1]](https://www.injectual.com/blogs/news/microneedling-with-polynucleotides-the-game-changer-for-skin-repair)
- **Scaring & Pigmentation:** Helps remodel acne scars and reduces post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.[[1]](https://thedoctorspractice.co.uk/dr-rinku-ratti-microneedling-polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://littleforay.com/blog/microneedling-polynucleotides-the-power-pairing-for-texture-tone-elasticity/)
- **Hydration & Firmness:** Attracts water molecules and strengthens thin, fragile skin without adding artificial volume or looking "overfilled."[[1]](https://www.westfieldclinic.co.uk/poly-microneedling)[[2]](https://littleforay.com/blog/microneedling-polynucleotides-the-power-pairing-for-texture-tone-elasticity/)
- **Low Downtime:** Most patients experience mild redness and minor surface bumps that resolve within 24 to 48 hours.[[1]](https://littleforay.com/blog/microneedling-polynucleotides-the-power-pairing-for-texture-tone-elasticity/)

### Treatment Protocol

- **Sessions:** Practitioners typically recommend a course of 3 sessions spaced roughly 3 to 4 weeks apart, followed by maintenance every 6 months.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DWRo8O1hBIL/)[[2]](https://littleforay.com/blog/microneedling-polynucleotides-the-power-pairing-for-texture-tone-elasticity/)
- **Alternatives:** Polynucleotides can also be administered via direct micro-injections rather than microneedling serums, depending on whether you are treating a broad surface area or a localized concern like hollow under-eyes.[[1]](https://www.harleystreetskinclinic.com/articles/polynucleotide-serum-for-microneedling-uk-guide/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DWRo8O1hBIL/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:4852085842223812585&ibp=oshop)

If you're considering this treatment, let me know:
